subject: 🏃 Thursday — 6 mi Easy / Deload Day 4 (Wk 8)
html:
Tomorrow you have 6 miles easy — HR Zone 2 (≤145 BPM), pace ~9:00–9:15 readout. Run from the door on the hilly home roads. HR governs, pace floats with the terrain. If a climb pulls HR above 145, ease off or walk the top until it drops back into Z2. This is the longest deload run of the week, but it’s still pure recovery — don’t let it creep into steady.

Pre-run activation (5 min): quadruped hip CARs, banded lateral walks (10 each direction), glute bridges (10), plus quadruped banded hip IR (5–10 reps each side, PT-prescribed). Extra today: add 2–3 minutes of gentle hamstring sweeps (standing leg swings, front-to-back, 10 each side) and foam-roll the right posterior chain (glute, hamstring, calf) before heading out. The right hamstring twinge you noted yesterday is almost certainly HM residue, but it’s in the problem leg so it gets a warmup, not a wave-off.

Focus cue: hamstring checkpoint. Pay attention to the right hamstring in miles 1–2 while it warms up. If the twinge resolves and disappears as you loosen up, that’s residual tightness clearing — carry on for all 6. If it sharpens, changes your stride, or moves from “twinge” toward a pull sensation, cut it short and walk home. Don’t test it. We need this leg healthy for Sunday’s 10-miler and the next 4.5 weeks of build.

Where you are: Week 8 of 12, deload day 4. 31 days to race day. Recovery is tracking — you were 80% back yesterday with a clean 1/5 knee and a textbook all-Z2 run. Tomorrow should feel easier still. Friday is the first post-HM consolidated strength + PT session (light, re-introducing load gently), then Sunday’s 10-mi long run doubles as the first fueling-fix rehearsal — practicing gels at effort, the #1 lesson from Presidio.

Tonight: Hydrate well, protein + carbs at dinner (fish tacos, salmon bowl, whatever’s easy). Foam-roll the right hamstring gently before bed — no aggressive static stretching on an irritated muscle. Bed by 10.
